issue.title: [syncd] syncd should handle SAI_REDIS_NOTIFY_SYNCD_INVOKE_DUMP even if temp view is not enabled

failure.body:
#### Description

At line https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-sairedis/blob/a988dd1b7b9044fd7ca859ecdfa1eb858cc3ea08/syncd/Syncd.cpp#L3759, the function`processNotifySyncd` will exit early if temp view is not enabled. It will even ignore SAI_REDIS_NOTIFY_SYNCD_INVOKE_DUMP notification. This is not reasonable.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Do a fast-reboot which will set m_commandLineOptions->m_enableTempView to false
2. Trigger a dump from orchagent

#### Describe the results you received:

syncd will not collect sai dump

#### Describe the results you expected:

syncd should collect sai dump

#### Output of `show version`:

```
(paste your output here)
```
#### Output of `show techsupport`:

```
(paste your output here or download and attach the file here )
```

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):

resolution.title: Moving SAI failure dump handling above the ignore for non temp view
resolution.description:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/19411

During fast reboot temp view is not used and any failure will not result in SAI failure dump taken. Hence moving the handling of SAI failure dump above the ignore of non temp view.
